source_paper_text:
A numerical semigroup S is an additive submonoid of the nonnegative integers with finite complement. Its genus g counts missing integers; F is the largest missing integer. Type t is |{x in Z\S: x+s in S for every positive s in S}|. Write n(g,t) for the number of such S. A leaf has every minimal positive generator at most F. Let L(g,t) count leaves. Unimodal means weakly increasing up to some index then weakly decreasing.

Conjecture 4.4 (faithful mathematical restatement): If S is a leaf of genus g>=2, write g=4q+r with 0<=r<4. Its type is at most 2q-1 for r=0 or 1, at most 2q for r=2, and at most 2q+1 for r=3.
